description: MUST-FAIL: integer >= 1e21 inside an array. Python json.dumps renders 10^21 as '1000000000000000000000' (full decimal digits) while JCS requires scientific notation ('1e+21'); the output diverges from the RFC 8785 canonical form. Implementations MUST reject this value even when nested in arrays. Regression vector for the array-bypass bug (Fix 1, round 2).
note: 10^21 = 1000000000000000000000. RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3 requires '1e+21'; Python json.dumps produces '1000000000000000000000'. An implementation using json.dumps for arrays will produce a non-canonical digest.
